app.title: AkkuCam Gateway
brand.name: AkkuCam
language.label: Language
help.title: How it works
help.text: Find a base station, open its cameras and start a live view without any cloud service.
help.wallText: Once the first camera list is loaded, the live wall fills the screen. Switch between Auto, Focus and Comfort, filter by base station, and open a tile for details.
wall.title: Live wall
setup.emptyHint: The base station must be powered on and on the same network as this gateway.
view.label: View
view.autoHint: Fills the screen with equal tiles sized from the camera count.
view.focusHint: One large camera, all others as a strip next to or below it.
view.comfortHint: Every tile gets its own header and controls.
settings.title: Wall settings
settings.liveDataHint: Bitrate, FPS and battery of running streams.
hubs.hint: Codes stay in browser memory until you reload the page. Start and stop each base station independently.
notice.stopBeforeDiscovery: Stop all streams before discovering again.
notice.stopBeforeReload: Stop all streams before reloading the camera list.
notice.loadingChannels: Signing in and loading the camera list…
notice.channelsFailed: Could not load the camera list: {detail}
notice.noChannels: The base station reports no paired cameras.
notice.stopBeforeAddHub: Stop all streams before adding a base station.
notice.forgotCode: Security code for {hub} removed from browser memory.
notice.forgotAllCodes: All security codes removed from browser memory.
notice.lockedByStreams: Stop all streams to change this.
camera.placeholder.title: Stream not running
camera.placeholder.hint: Start the stream to wake the camera.
camera.meta.name: Device name
camera.playlistTimeout: The video stream did not start in time.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.hint: DIDs, addresses and manual channel fallback
diagnostics.manualHint: Only use this if the base station does not return a camera list.
diagnostics.forgetCode: Remove all security codes from browser memory
dialog.title: Enter security code
dialog.hint: The code stays in browser memory for this base station until you reload or close this page.
dialog.label: Device security code
dialog.codeWarning: This displays the security code on screen.
